an7.41:1.1: “Meditators, having seven qualities Sāriputta has mastered his mind and is not mastered by it.
an7.41:1.3: Sāriputta is skilled at composure, skilled in entering composure, skilled in remaining in composure, skilled in emerging from composure, skilled in positivity for composure, skilled in the territory of composure, and skilled in projecting the mind purified by composure.
an7.41:1.4: Having these seven qualities Sāriputta has mastered his mind and is not mastered by it.”
